summary.text: Todd Nash is a Republican member of the Oregon State Senate for District 29, which his legislative page associates with Enterprise.
His biography describes him as a small cattle ranch owner and former Wallowa County commissioner, and as the first senator in Oregon's history from Wallowa County.

paragraphs.text: Nash has lived in the region since age five, according to his biography, and has worked in the timber, farming and ranching industries.
Before his election to the Senate he served as president of the Oregon Cattlemen's Association and held leadership roles with the Association of Oregon Counties.
His committee assignments include vice chair of Natural Resources and Wildfire, Housing and Development, and Human Services.
His biography credits him with helping pass Senate Bill 955 in 2023, which created the Oregon Agri-Stress Hotline.
He and his wife, Angie, have four children and six grandchildren, who the page says all live in Wallowa County.
